fusion_influences: Swiss Haute Horlogerie & Savile Row bespoke tailoring precision
Warm Cognac & Obsidian leather atelier textures

hero_and_motion_strategy.kinetic_intro: Masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion stagger variants on page load
hero_and_motion_strategy.parallax_moment: 3D interactive tilt card / depth mouse-reactive spotlight on the interior hero showcase
hero_and_motion_strategy.slow_editorial_marquee: Continuous slow-drift artisanal manifesto ribbon with luxury badges and values
hero_and_motion_strategy.hover_states: Micro-haptics with subtle gold border glow, image scale (scale-105), and custom cursor accent

sections_breakdown.description: Crystal glass floating sticky navigation with logo badge, curated links (Manifesto, Services, Atelier Gallery, Reviews, Inquiries), and 'Book Session' CTA.
Awwwards-level kinetic hero with line-by-line mask reveal, tactile gold badges 'Woman-Owned & Operated Interior Atelier', bespoke CTAs, and interactive focal spotlight interior teaser.
Slow editorial ribbon sliding across the screen with bespoke values: 'HAND-STITCHED PRECISION • STEAM & STEAM OIL INFUSION • pH-NEUTRAL LEATHER NOURISHMENT • FEMALE ARTISANSHIP • ZERO HARSH ODORS'.

Numbered manifesto chapters (Chapter 01: The Touch of Care, Chapter 02: Biological & Material Purity, Chapter 03: The Woman-Led Difference) with high-density editorial storytelling and clipped spotlight visuals.

Tiered bespoke interior packages (The Alcantara Restorative, Bespoke Aniline Leather Spa, Concierge Interior Preservation, Clean Air & Ozone Ionization) with interactive package selector, detail drawers, and direct booking pre-fill.
Curated spotlight gallery with zoom modal, before/after inspection slider, and macro leather stitch close-ups.
Editorial quote carousels and verified client accolades (Porsche, Aston Martin, Tesla, Range Rover owners).

Full-fledged booking inquiry form connected to FastAPI backend (`/api/enquiries`), with vehicle make/model, interior leather condition selector, preferred package, date picker, and admin enquiry drawer to view stored submissions.
High-contrast massive serif typographic footer with studio location, operating hours, direct concierge hotline, and discreet admin portal link.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lenis (@studio-freight/lenis or lenis) or implement smooth momentum scroll using framer-motion / Lenis hook.
Ensure backend in FastAPI has SQLite/in-memory storage for enquiries POST /api/enquiries and GET /api/enquiries.
Add an Admin Enquiry Viewer modal or drawer on the frontend so the client can inspect all submitted bookings.
Implement the kinetic line-by-line masked reveal in the Hero component using framer-motion.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, and filters have explicit `data-testid` attributes.
Avoid generic bootstrap cards; style with border-border/40, dark glassmorphism, subtle gold rim lighting, and generous spacing (p-8 to p-16).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_ai_slop: Use asymmetric layouts, luxury serif headers (Playfair Display / Cormorant), mono labels, and micro-interactions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast_rule: Every text item on dark backgrounds must be high-contrast and legible (#F8F8F8 for headings, #A1A1AA for body).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.motion: Add hover lift, glow border transitions, and smooth entrance reveals on scroll using framer-motion.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for toast notifications on form submission and enquiry booking.
